content.title: Met Office issues yellow snow warning
content.caption: The Met Office has issued a yellow snow warning for parts of northern England and southern Scotland due to heavy snowfall.

slides.heading: Met Office issues yellow snow warning
slides.text: The Met Office has issued a yellow snow warning for parts of northern England and southern Scotland due to heavy snowfall.

slides.heading: Snowfall and Weather Conditions
slides.text: Heavy snowfall is expected in parts of northern England and southern Scotland due to a weather front pushing north and east across the UK.

slides.heading: Impact on Transportation
slides.text: A Met Office yellow warning for snow is in place, with 5-15cm expected at some locations above 300-400m elevation, affecting major routes like the A74(M), A66, and M62.
